submission.justification: Crystal-K3 at 5 cm thickness provides the best energy resolution (4.384% FWHM at 662 keV) among all viable options. Crystal-K1, despite having superior light yield and better resolution potential (2.9% at 5 cm), must be excluded because its intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day significantly exceeds the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day. Crystal-K2, while having excellent radiopurity (0.10 counts/kg/day), suffers from much poorer energy resolution (8.867% at best) due to lower light yield. Crystal-K3 strikes the optimal balance with acceptable background (0.30 counts/kg/day, well within budget) and the best achievable resolution among compliant options. The simulation reveals that 5 cm thickness optimizes the energy resolution for Crystal-K3, achieving 4.384% compared to 4.405% at 4 cm and 4.553% at 6 cm.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K3 is one of the three candidates: Crystal-K1, Crystal-K2, and Crystal-K3

requirements.requirement: Intrinsic background of the crystal (100-3000 keV) must not exceed 0.5 counts/kg/day
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K3 background measured at 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day, which is below the 0.5 counts/kg/day budget
Recommended thickness of 5 cm is within the allowed range of 2-10 cm

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K3 at 5 cm achieves 4.384% FWHM at 662 keV, the best resolution among background-compliant options. Crystal-K1 would have better resolution (2.9%) but violates the background constraint with 2.0 counts/kg/day. Crystal-K2 has significantly worse resolution (8.867% at best).
